messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a sharp 95th/99th pctl latency bump in prod GPU pool A around 03:12 UTC.
Some quick correlation: bursty long-context batches went up at the same time and KV cache paging/churn spiked.

maria: Logs (tail):
```
2026-03-17T03:12:11Z INFO pager: allocate page id=0x7f9a reuse_window_ms=120
2026-03-17T03:12:11Z WARN evicter: reinserted key=k:abcd order_index=42
2026-03-17T03:12:11Z WARN evicter: evicted key=k:ffff expected_oldest=k:aaaa actual=k:bbbb
2026-03-17T03:12:11Z DEBUG lock: evict_lock wait_ns=1200000
```

maria: Notably we saw multiple "evicted expected_oldest != actual" warnings. That smells like replacement-order inversion under concurrent reinserts.

sam: Can you paste the perf counters / mini-profile from the time window? :eyes:

maria: Pasted quick perf: 
```
evict_lock_wait_ns: 1.2ms
reinsert_count: 3.4k
reinsert_promote_hits: 1.9k
reuse_hits: 8.7k
pager_io_ops: 420
kv_list_len_mean: 512
```

sam: Hmm reinsert_promote_hits being so high during burst could push things ahead of the tail. If the reinsert path promotes without coordinating with the eviction cursor, ordering invariants could be violated.

lee: I suspect the problem is the non-atomic two-step remove-then-insert used in reinsert_promotion. Under contention a concurrent eviction may have scanned the node as "candidate for eviction" and then we reinsert it ahead, so the evicter ends up removing a different node than it thought. That matches the "expected_oldest != actual" log.

noah: I can repro with a synthetic harness. Command I used: 
```
./kv_harness --concurrency=64 --batch-size-dist=long-tail --op-mix=read:0.6,write:0.4 --reinsert-pct=40 --duration=300s
```
noah: Repro reliably in ~30s locally. I'll attach flame graphs after I run perf (stack shows contention in evict_lock + list_remove).

olivia: Short-term mitigation: can we flip the policy to avoid immediate promotion on reinsert? We have a knob kv.reinsert_promotion_enabled = true/false. Suggest turning it off on canary (makes eviction slower but keeps ordering stable).

infra-bot: Toggling kv.reinsert_promotion_enabled -> false on canary cluster "gpu-a-canary" (3 nodes). Rollout started by @olivia at 2026-03-17T03:25:00Z.

maria: After toggle, 95th dropped back to normal in ~90s. Looks promising. :thumbsup:

sam: Action items:
- sam: add an invariant assert in debug builds that verifies eviction cursor's expected_oldest == actual before remove (detect order inversion)
- lee: instrument reinsert path with sequence numbers and a CAS-based promote variant prototype
- noah: run harness with and without promotion under various batch distributions and capture flame graphs
- olivia/infra: keep canary toggled and monitor for regressions (rollback plan ready).

lee: Quick note: this may interact with batching heuristics. Larger batch sizes = more simultaneous KV inserts per request which amplifies the race window. We should also log batch sizes in reproducer.

noah: I'll post perf artifacts: flamegraph link -> https://artifacts.internal/redwood/kv/repro/1749802042/flame.svg (will update with callstacks and counts)

sam: If the CAS promote variant fixes it, we can ship a safer promote that does a CAS on the list head pointer; fallback to disable-promotion if CAS fails repeatedly.

maria: Good plan. Please update this thread when you have repro artifacts. Thanks everyone.

olivia: Monitoring note: added alert that fires if "evicter.expected_mismatch > 0" for > 3 events / 1m.

maria: Copy — will watch. :eyes:
